newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates thinly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates thinly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted Tuesday on St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No trades were posted Tuesday versus 25 barges traded Friday. The market was closed Monday in observance of U.S. Labor Day.
- Two barges, this week, Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), 90 percent of tariff bid, no offer.
- Two barges, this week, lower Ohio river, no bid, 110 percent offered.
- Five barges, one each week of September, Mid-Mississippi, bid 145 percent, no offer.
- Five barges, one each week of September, lower Ohio river,bid 145 percent, no offer.
- Four barges, one each week of November, Illinois, no bid, offered 200 percent.
